# Core I/O Verification — verify complete write/read/append/delete contract

# Input files for note operations

# Input files for ADR operations

# Input files for error cases

# === VERIFICATION SETUP ===

# Initialize KB
exec akb init test-kb
stdout 'Initialized KB "test-kb"'

cd test-kb

# Verify KB structure exists
exists kb
exists raw
exists .akb
exists .akb/templates

# === WRITE OPERATIONS ===

# Write a note to kb/notes/
stdin ../note-input.md
exec akb write gate-note.md
stdout 'Written to kb/notes/gate-note.md'

# Verify note file exists in correct location
exists kb/notes/gate-note.md

# Write an ADR to kb/decisions/
stdin ../adr-input.md
exec akb write gate-adr.md
stdout 'Written to kb/decisions/gate-adr.md'

# Verify ADR file exists in correct location
exists kb/decisions/gate-adr.md

# === READ OPERATIONS ===

# Read the note back
exec akb read notes/gate-note.md
stdout 'Verification Note'
stdout 'type: note'
stdout 'Note content for verification.'

# Read the ADR back
exec akb read decisions/gate-adr.md
stdout 'Verification ADR'
stdout 'type: adr'
stdout 'ADR content for verification.'

# === APPEND OPERATIONS ===

# Append to note
stdin ../append-input.md
exec akb append notes/gate-note.md
stdout 'Appended to kb/notes/gate-note.md'

# Verify frontmatter preserved and content extended
exec akb read notes/gate-note.md
stdout 'type: note'
stdout 'Verification Note'
stdout 'Note content for verification.'
stdout 'Appended content line.'

# === DELETE OPERATIONS ===

# Delete the note
exec akb delete notes/gate-note.md
stdout 'Deleted kb/notes/gate-note.md'

# Verify file removed
! exists kb/notes/gate-note.md

# Delete the ADR
exec akb delete decisions/gate-adr.md
stdout 'Deleted kb/decisions/gate-adr.md'

# Verify file removed
! exists kb/decisions/gate-adr.md

# === ERROR CASES ===

# Unknown type error includes template suggestion
stdin ../unknown-type-input.md
! exec akb write bad-type.md
stderr 'unknown type'
stderr 'Create .akb/templates'

# Missing type error
stdin ../no-type-input.md
! exec akb write no-type.md
stderr 'missing required field'

# Missing title error
stdin ../no-title-input.md
! exec akb write no-title.md
stderr 'missing required field'

# raw/ prefix error on write
stdin ../note-input.md
! exec akb write raw/notes/test.md
stderr 'akb raw write'

# raw/ prefix error on read
! exec akb read raw/notes/test.md
stderr 'akb raw read'

# raw/ prefix error on delete
! exec akb delete raw/notes/test.md
stderr 'akb raw delete'

# raw/ prefix error on append
stdin ../note-input.md
! exec akb append raw/notes/test.md
stderr 'akb raw write'

# === --no-commit FLAG ===

# Re-create note for no-commit test
stdin ../note-input.md
exec akb --no-commit write nocommit-note.md
stdout 'Written to kb/notes/nocommit-note.md'

# Verify file exists
exists kb/notes/nocommit-note.md

# Verify NO git commit was created
exec git status --short
stdout ''

# === GIT COMMIT MESSAGE FORMAT ===

# Write creates commit with proper format
stdin ../note-input.md
exec akb write final-note.md

exec git log --oneline -1
stdout 'akb: write kb/notes/final-note.md'

# Append creates commit with proper format
stdin ../append-input.md
exec akb append notes/final-note.md

exec git log --oneline -1
stdout 'akb: append kb/notes/final-note.md'

# Delete creates commit with proper format
exec akb delete notes/final-note.md

exec git log --oneline -1
stdout 'akb: delete kb/notes/final-note.md'

-- note-input.md --
---
type: note
title: Verification Note
summary: Testing core I/O verification
tags: test
---
Note content for verification.

-- append-input.md --
Appended content line.

-- adr-input.md --
---
type: adr
title: Verification ADR
status: proposed
deciders: team
summary: Testing core I/O verification
tags: test
created: '2026-01-01'
updated: '2026-09-01'
---
## Context

ADR content for verification.

## Decision

Decided.

## Consequences

Recorded.

type: nonexistent
title: Unknown Type Test
---
Content

---
Content

Content
